label: Tessera · Features
description: Editable features section for the Tessera design.

defaults.heading:
Four building blocks.
One source of truth.
defaults.description: Database, auth, realtime, and functions share a single schema, so they never disagree.

items.title: Database
items.description: Postgres, with types that follow you. Every branch gets its own copy of the data.

items.title: Auth
items.description: Email, OAuth, or magic links, with access rules next to the data they protect.

items.title: Realtime
items.description: Every query can be a subscription, with presence and broadcast built in.

items.title: Functions
items.description: Server code without the servers. Attach a trigger and it runs close to your data.
